incidents.title_zh_cn: Releases 分发站短时响应变慢
incidents.title_zh_tw: Releases 分發站短暫回應變慢
incidents.body_zh_cn: 2026-09-23 约 14:00 起，部分用户反映 Releases 分发站响应变慢。工程组定位为 CDN 边缘节点缓存刷新延迟，已于当日修复，目前持续监控中。
incidents.body_zh_tw: 2026-09-23 約 14:00 起，部分使用者反映 Releases 分發站回應變慢。工程團隊定位為 CDN 邊緣節點快取重新整理延遲，已於當日修復，目前持續監控中。
incidents.body_en: Since ~14:00 on 2026-09-23 some users reported slow responses from the Releases CDN. The cause was identified as delayed cache refresh at CDN edge nodes and was fixed the same day; we continue to monitor.
